rules.description: Each incoming request is compared with the record at the current cursor only.
A later record with the same replay key must not be consumed when the current record mismatches.
Operation, capability, replay_key, or request_hash differences emit a mismatch finding with expected and actual values.
Records at or after the final cursor emit unconsumed_record findings after replay requests are exhausted.
Summary fields, finding kind order, and matched record IDs are stable across equivalent fixture runs.
